# Pi-Kiosk boot config fragments
# These are appended to /boot/config.txt during image build

# PoE HAT — enable fan control overlay (official PoE HAT)
dtoverlay=poehat
# PoE HAT fan speed control via I2C
dtparam=poehat_fan_temp0=50000,poehat_fan_temp1=60000,poehat_fan_temp2=70000,poehat_fan_temp3=80000

# I2C — required for HAT detection, PoE fan, GPS HAT, HaLo HAT
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
dtparam=i2c_vc=on

# SPI — required for LoRa/radio HATs (SX127x/SX126x)
dtparam=spi=on

# Serial — disable serial console to free /dev/ttyAMA0 for GPS/radio HATs
# Keep serial hardware enabled but disable login shell on it
enable_uart=1
# Disable bluetooth on Pi 4 to free /dev/serial0 for HAT use
# (uncomment if using a GPS/radio HAT on the GPIO serial pins)
# dtoverlay=disable-bt

# Audio — enable onboard audio (for Audio/Mic HAT compatibility)
dtparam=audio=on

# Camera
start_x=1

# GPU memory — ensure enough for camera + kiosk UI
gpu_mem=256
